epoch_selection: first three-fold GroupKFold split of fit cases; earliest minimum case-averaged physical validation MSE over 30 epochs
temperature_increment: (Tout[t+1]-Tout[t]) multiplied by training Tout MinMax scale, no additive offset
heat_increment: (Q[t+1]-Q[t]) in MJ divided by training-origin increment RMS
stacking: unconstrained float64 linear regression on physical base predictions; add latest observed state once for incremental variant
refit_epochs: train through max(10, selected_epoch), retain checkpoint at selected_epoch
input_channels: scaled logQ at window[-2] minus window[0], repeated
history_source: observed values from the corresponding simulated trajectory during training and inference
tableA5: pooled RMSE separately per seed, then arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1)
tableA6: pool E01/E02 rows within each seed before computing RMSE; summarize four seeds afterwards
